decisions.quote: We were unable to find significantly higher RMET scores after reading literary fiction compared to any of the other conditions. In short, we found no support for any short-term causal effects of reading literary fiction on theory of mind.
decisions.reason: The study found no support for the central short-term causal effect of reading literary fiction on RMET scores across any of the tested experimental comparisons. Per the codebook, because the central finding focused on in the paper's title failed to replicate, the outcome is failed regardless of the covariate correlation for the Author Recognition Test control measure.

parent_source_inspection.note: Discussion explicitly rejects short-term causal reading effect, distinguishes ART lifetime-exposure correlation; original focal causal target failed.
